SELECT pi.device_id, p.name AS plantName, AVG(ed.temperature) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.temperature", AVG(ed.humidity) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.humidity", AVG(ed.light_intensity) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.lightIntensity", AVG(ed.soil_moisture) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.soilMoisture", AVG(ed.co2_concentration) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.co2Concentration", MAX(ed.recorded_time) AS "dailyEnvironmentDataVO.recordedTime" FROM smart_agriculture.plant_instance pi LEFT JOIN smart_agriculture.environment_data ed ON ed.plant_instance_id = pi.id and ed.recorded_time >= CURDATE() AND ed.recorded_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) LEFT JOIN smart_agriculture.plant p ON pi.plant_id = p.id WHERE pi.device_id IN
#{deviceId}
and p.name is not null
GROUP BY p.name,DATE(ed.recorded_time)
